title: ADD-REPO-INTEGRATE-COMMAND

iterations.prompt: Add a new command to repo called integrate <source> <target-section-name> <target-file> [<target-parent-section-name>] that takes code files and integrates the source code into a target file by wrapping it into the target section. Optionally provide a target parent section name to place the new section under. Otherwise it will just be placed at the end of the file after the last section.
iterations.author: Ueli Saluz <ueli.saluz@iek.uni-hannover.de>

summary: Implemented integrate command across CLI, MCP, GraphQL and VS Code extension.
